title: Interesting Tomb raider esk type Mall dream
content: So I had an interesting Mallworld dream last night. The Mall was a buried mall in a dystopia world to get into the mall there was a giant slide that goes on for over 20 stories. The top 3 stories had shops, but since it's dystopian it only sold survivor stuff. The lower floors where a work in progress. In the dream I was part of a crew that worked on building lifts between floors. To get the lifts in place we had to first install ladders to get in between floors. So my whole dream was me climbing up old vines to tie the rope ladder in. A lot of climbing in the dream. Ironically even though dystopia it felt like things have stabilized In the dream and is undergoing a new golden age. Like a Non violent Renaissance Mad Max. Will try to add AI pics later on today or tomorrow.
